HP3The home page, for individuals and coaches
COACH MILAN, 1 NOVEMBER 10:48 TO 11:23
The page targets coaches and individuals. Beta testers get free access, spots are limited, and testing asks for commitment. Real users will pay; they form a waiting list, separate from the beta.
THE TOP
The promise and the crave calculator stay. The top bar gets For coaches. The box under the calculator: Join the beta, free; the spots left, from the number you set under Coach; the commitment: use it most days for four weeks, and tell us what breaks; a link to the waiting list.
FOR THE INDIVIDUAL
The day in order. Start from anything: two clips, not four. One plate. Plan and shop. New: Cook it, hands free. New: Your day as it really goes (situations, calendar, Travel mode). New: Explorer, know why, not only what.
FOR THE COACH
A section of its own, at For coaches: one account, two views; suggest, the client accepts; answer or react on shared meals; Waiting for you; the client decides what you see. Its own button: Get a coach code.
TRUST
Two lines more: papers read again before each release; an account nobody opens for 12 months is deleted.
TWO FORMS
Join the beta, free: as today, with the spots and the commitment. The waiting list: email, Which fits you?, a tick to be written to when it opens. When the spots reach 0, the waiting list becomes the main button. The book page's round-is-full line points to it.
THE STILLS
The new sections show the app as it is in 0.3.38, with made-up names. Clips come after this board is approved, recorded by rules HC1 to HC10.
NOT IN THIS BOARD
Prices. The launch email and its double opt-in (an EU mail tool, at launch). The rulebook (DT197).
